description: A TV-optimized media browsing interface featuring a side navigation bar, a featured hero banner, and horizontal scrolling media carousels.

sidebar.layout: Fixed left, full height, flex column.
elements: Icon Navigation (Search, Home, Trending, Live TV, Monitor, Add, Profile)
Active State: gray.800 background, rounded corners, white icon.

topNavigation.layout: Flex row, horizontal, spaced evenly, aligned left.

heroSection.layout: Relative container, full width (minus sidebar), top area of screen.
heroSection.background: Full cover image with accent.heroOverlay applied to ensure text legibility.

actions.label: Watch Now
actions.style: White background, black text, rounded-md, flex row, centered.

actions.label: Favourite
actions.style: Transparent background, white 1px border, white text, rounded-md.

actions.label: Share
actions.style: Transparent background, white 1px border, white text, rounded-md.

carouselSection.title: Trending Now
carouselSection.layout: Horizontal scrolling flex container, gap 1.5rem, overflow-x visible.

cards.aspectRatio: approx 3:4 or 16:9 depending on poster type (posters shown are roughly 1:1.2)
cards.focusState: Scale up (1.05x), apply 4px solid accent.focusRing (White), elevate z-index.
